stacks.label: Monthly equal-weight scheduled portfolio
stacks.locator: docs/source/intro.ipynb code cell5,exact bt.Strategy Call,name s1
stacks.selection: Select all current universe columns with available positive current prices; include_no_data=false,include_negative=false
stacks.weights: Each selected asset receives1/N; no selections gives empty targets
stacks.rebalance: On monthly schedule,close holdings absent from targets and move selected holdings toward weights using a saved pre-rebalance portfolio-value base
stacks.hypothesis: Scheduled allocation/rebalancing,not a directional alpha signal. Useful as a portfolio baseline/control,not evidence of a newly profitable bot.
stacks.family_overlap: Different allocation and shared-cash mechanics from single-symbol fresh adaptations. Shares market exposure and calendar timing with existing research; no statistical independence claim.

stacks.label: Weekly inverse-volatility portfolio
stacks.locator: docs/source/intro.ipynb code cell14,exact bt.Strategy Call,name s2
stacks.selection: Same positive-current-price SelectAll policy; there is no momentum rank,trend filter or return-sign entry condition
stacks.weight_calculation: For selected assets,slice prices from current timestamp minus3calendar months through current timestamp,lag0; compute price returns and per-column sample standard deviation; normalize inverse volatility. Infinite reciprocals become missing; drop missing weights.
special_cases: No selected assets gives empty weights
One selected asset gets100%without estimating volatility
All invalid/zero-volatility reciprocals can produce empty weights and therefore deallocation
No maximum asset weight,covariance/risk-parity solver or total-volatility target is added
stacks.history_boundary: Source does not demand a full3calendar-month history before calculation. A common240bar8h warmup is80days and does not itself guarantee3calendar months; adding a completeness requirement changes source admission and must be declared.
stacks.family_overlap: Portfolio sizing by relative risk is a different decision from prior single-symbol entries,but uses volatility information already present in VOL8/ATR and other frozen/rejected research. Shared data and broad factor overlap remain; no independent edge claim.

shared_schedule_semantics.bootstrap: Backtest adds a synthetic reference row; index0 does not run. First actual input date at index1 is eligible by default.
shared_schedule_semantics.monthly: Year or month differs from previous input row
shared_schedule_semantics.weekly: ISO year/week differs from previous input row
shared_schedule_semantics.endpoint_blocker: Last input row takes a separate run_on_last_date=false branch,even if it is a new calendar period. Full-series versus truncated-prefix decisions can therefore differ at the endpoint. This is static evidence requiring synthetic verification,not a claimed observed native test.
shared_schedule_semantics.warmup_blocker: Suppressing orders before a research admission does not automatically make that admission a source first date. Forcing an initial rebalance at admission would need an explicit source-intent adaptation.
shared_schedule_semantics.timestamp_blocker: 8h open-labeled versus close-labeled UTC timestamps change which completed feature row is the first in a week/month. Date labels,timezone and next-open execution must be fixed before registration.

native_order_and_accounting.clock: Backtest.run updates the strategy at the current price-row date,executes strategy.run,and updates again. Rebalance allocates using current-row prices. It is not an asynchronous next-opening exchange market-order model.
native_order_and_accounting.target_base: Rebalance preserves pre-allocation portfolio value while processing target deltas; an optional cash key scales investable targets,but neither published stack sets one.
native_order_and_accounting.allocation: Core StrategyBase.rebalance lines1067-1129 delegates weight-delta value to SecurityBase.allocate lines1613-1757. Default integer positions floor/ceil share adjustments. Allocation iteratively adjusts quantity for commission outlay; this is not the prior fixed-unit all-or-reject order policy.
native_order_and_accounting.deallocation: Holdings omitted from target weights are closed before target allocations; selected targets are then processed in target iteration order. Invalid direct target prices are prevalidated by Rebalance._validate_target_prices lines1959-1995.
native_order_and_accounting.funding_limit: Shared-cash sale/purchase ordering,fees,rounding,partial portfolio rebalances and failure atomicity have not been executed or proved here. Do not assume stock-unit rounding equals crypto lots or that a rebalance is one indivisible exchange order.
native_order_and_accounting.economics: No research spread/fee/slippage stress model is provided by the two example constructors. Source commission=None and accounting defaults do not authorize weakening frozen economics.
native_order_and_accounting.native_proof: NONE: no library installation,synthetic/native backtest or market run performed in this survey

dependency_limits.not_locked: The project dependency declaration does not fix an exact ffn/pandas/numpy runtime. to_returns and external-price preprocessing need a pinned dependency closure or a separately declared own mathematical equivalent before native parity claims.
dependency_limits.default_prices: Adjusted equity/bond closes and their provider/calendar handling are not Binance Spot OHLCV. Reusing published allocation formulas does not establish unchanged market or execution semantics.

momentum_lead_not_invented.finding: n is required. Default lookback3calendar months,lag0,descending=true,all_or_none=false do not define a complete portfolio without n,universe,schedule and weighting/execution stack.
momentum_lead_not_invented.decision: No top-one/top-k momentum bot was synthesized from component defaults or selected from outcomes. This component inspection is not a third admitted source or trial.

Prove schedule prefix/endpoint behavior,first eligible admission,missing/zero/constant-price and one-asset edge cases with synthetic fixtures
Pin runtime and calculate exact inverse-volatility returns/standard-deviation conventions; do not retune lookback,lag,schedule or caps
Define portfolio turnover/trade-event clusters,negative controls,matched BTC benchmark and costs prospectively; do not reinterpret single-position gates after seeing results
